warnings: This drawing set prints NO grid bubbles at all — only dimension chains (x 8 × 1.20 = 9.60, y 5 × 1.20 = 6.00). Labels were assigned here: numbers 1-5 on the column lines along x (every 2.40), letters A-F on the column rows along y (every 1.20); the 1.20 ticks between column lines are dummies. Every 'named' line carries that note and a grid_label_assigned_not_printed flag.

The four corner mooring footings (F1 + RC post C0) sit outside the floating frame, diagonally off its corners; their offset is not dimensioned, so A'/F' (≈0.75) are scaled and flagged. Their x matches the end column lines.
Architectural PDF (separate file) was not swept.
